# Card coverage

<!-- generated by `make coverage`; edit cmd/forgec/coverage.go, not this file -->

gorge compiles [Card-Forge/forge](https://github.com/Card-Forge/forge)'s card
scripts into an IR and implements the primitives that IR names. A card counts
as **playable** here when every primitive its script references is implemented;
one missing primitive makes the whole card unplayable, so this is a strict
lower bound on what the engine can do.

- Cards in the corpus: **33667**
- Fully playable: **30585 (90.8%)**
- Token scripts compiled: **839**
- Corpus pin: `Card-Forge/forge@95f04e8a04c8925fa97cb226fc3341cabcc90a53`

## Why not by set?

Forge card scripts carry no set or edition data: a script is one card's
behaviour, independent of which set printed it. Set membership lives in a
separate Forge resource tree that `forgec fetch` deliberately does not pull.
So the breakdown below groups by what the compiled IR does carry — card type,
colour and mana value. Card type is the informative axis: it tracks which
engine subsystems are finished.
